title: A Uniqueness Theorem for Exact Separable Log-Partition Decompositions
summary: Let $\mathcal{X}$ be a finite set, let $p$ and $Q$ be strictly positive probability distributions on $\mathcal{X}$, and let $u\in\mathbb{R}^{\mathcal{X}}$ be a log-weight. Define $Ψ_p(u)=\log\sum_x p(x)e^{u(x)}$ and $π_{p,u}(x)=p(x)e^{u(x)-Ψ_p(u)}$. The variational free energy $F(Q;p,u)=D(Q\|p)-\mathbb{E}_Q[u]$ satisfies the exact identity $Ψ_p(u)=-F(Q;p,u)+D(Q\|π_{p,u})$, whose residual is the canonical divergence of the dually flat simplex.
